content.title: Here’s What Best Actress Nominees Wore to the 2026 Oscars
content.text: With the 2026 Oscars finally here, we’re guessing it’ll be a night to remember! While some categories might be easier to decide than others, this year’s Best Actress in the Motion Picture categories are truly a clash of titans.The stars nominated for Best Actress in a Leading Role are Jessie Buckley for Hamnet, Rose Byrne for If I Had Legs I’d Kick You, Kate Hudson for Song Sung Blue, Renate Reinsve for Sentimental Value, and Emma Stone for Bugonia.As for the Best Actress in a Supporting Role nominees, there’s Elle Fanning for Sentimental Value, Inga Ibsdotter Lilleaas for Sentimental Value, Amy Madigan for Weapons, Wunmi Mosaku for Sinners, and Teyana Taylor for One Battle After Another.And we’re sure all of them will turn heads with their gorgeous looks!Check out what all the Best Actress & Supporting Actress nominees wore on the 2026 Oscars red carpet below!More from SheKnowsBest of SheKnowsSign up for SheKnows' Newsletter.
